title: What’s the One Comeback in Housing? | Real Estate Market Update
description:
Are high mortgage rates finally coming down? The real estate market is seeing a shift as mortgage rates drop, and by the end of the year, we could witness even lower rates! With this, buyers may re-enter the market, and we could see the return of multiple offer scenarios. 🏘️💼

Hi, I’m Gloria Miller with REAL Broker and McElroy Property Group. As inflation cools, so does the economy, and experts predict not one but two interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve before 2024 ends. According to Realtor.com’s Chief Economist, more buyers are expected to return this Fall and Winter, opening up new opportunities in the housing market. Sellers may also list more homes, bringing competition back into play. But keep in mind, as the fourth quarter approaches, the real estate market tends to slow down.

Want to know how you can benefit from these changes? Contact us today for a comprehensive market update! 📞 We’re here to help you navigate the real estate market, whether buying or selling your home. People over profits, always.
